        - paragraph: In simple English
        - heading "Understand Newton's Method" [level=2]
        - paragraph: "Newton's method uses tangent lines to approximate roots of equations. In Newton's Method, that statement is the exact rule used on the labelled chart and in the three numerical examples. A useful rule is Newton update: x_{n+1}=x_n-f(x_n)/f'(x_n). You can learn Newton's Method by trying one small example instead of long theory."
        - paragraph: Choose a starting estimate. Evaluate f and f'. Apply the update formula. Repeat and check the residual. Try the example below. Write your steps and choose an answer before opening the comparison.
        - paragraph: "In real life, solving equations: Approximate roots when exact solving is hard. Watch out: Trusting an iteration without checking f(x). Check that the residual is small."
